texts.name: Umender
texts.biography: The elderly Umender had spent much time studying mechanical operation; he was an expert in the field. It was precisely because of this that, after arriving in Burton by chance, he developed many strange mechanical devices for King Kastore. But he was not satisfied with his current achievements.

specialty.name: Automatons
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of any Automatons or Sentinel Automatons by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
